Back problems are the most common reason for inability to work in Germany.

  • Audits: You prepare and follow up on external audits with the notified body, and plan and conduct internal audits. Your first milestone: the ISO 13485 recertification audit in February 2027 – with a stable system, complete documentation, and a planned handover by your predecessor.

  • Releases & Post-Market Surveillance: You review and approve release documentation and are responsible for post-market surveillance of our products.

  • Regulatory Radar: You evaluate regulatory changes monthly and derive concrete measures.

Whether the role of PRRC (Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance) becomes part of the function will be discussed together during the selection process – depending on your qualification and a clear agreement on responsibilities.

  • Corporate Benefits: Exclusive benefits for shopping, tech, and more.
